remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks notes inscription 1 and indicates, "Back: 'Near Abiquiú, N. Mex #2" [not verified]. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate in 1931–32 New York (An American Place) exhibition; pictured in Norman installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 51a. Backing inscription dates 1931. Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1930. Dated 1931 on basis of Stieglitz—O'Keeffe correspondence. Reproduced and titled *Toward Abique, New Mexico* in *Contemporary Arts of the South and Southwest* (November — December 1932). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
